title: Health Wearables, Gamification, and Healthful Activity
near_miss_reason: Individual-specific trends in every column: Table 2 column 1 adds i.id#c.oWeek (linear) and every other column, plus the Figure 2 event study, adds i.id#c.oWeek and i.id#c.oWeek#c.oWeek (quadratic) to individual and week FE (PROTOCOL 5b unit-trend rule). Table 2 column 3 also uses IPTW pweights, columns 6 and Tables 3-5 add treatment x moderator interactions. Shipped data are fictitious.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design: lb = 1 from the week a NetHealth participant joins a Fitbit leaderboard (firstWeek varies by participant), never-adopters as controls, xtreg fe with individual FE and i.oWeek (week FE). Every reported column also includes individual-specific linear or quadratic trends.
design_notes: table2.do: a1 xtreg steps i.oWeek i.id#c.oWeek lb, fe robust; a2 $table2BaseModel lb (adds quadratic trends); a6 IPTW pweight; deAdoption1 drops retractedLB; actualLB_4weeks (drop oWeek >= firstWeek+4); placeboLB4 (fake last four pre-weeks); inviter interaction. table3-5.do: lb x continuous moderators (firstlag, lbsizerev, lsa2rev, nocompbetlag, highfighting) and prior-activity subsamples. figure2.do: z_adoptionT_2..z_adoptionT_19 + lastPeriod with the same trends. Log (real data): Table 2 col 1 lb = 338.38 (171.40), col 2 = 370.46 (170.66), N = 27,758, 516 individuals, robust SEs.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Real-data cohort count not recoverable (weeklyFitbitData.dta not shipped); the fictitious file has 11 treated participants with 11 distinct first weeks and 5 never-treated.

specs.treatment_definition: 1 from the week the participant joins a leaderboard
specs.cluster: robust (Huber-White, xtreg fe robust => clustered by id)

specs.sample_condition: all; col 7 drops retracted leaderboards; actualLB_4weeks drops oWeek >= firstWeek+4

specs.fe: id + i.oWeek + individual linear and quadratic trends
